about.label: TENTANG SEPTIAN, S.KOM.
about.p1: Memulai karir sejak Oktober 2017 sebagai IT Support lapangan tunggal hingga dipercaya memimpin sebagai Head of IT Support untuk 8 cabang retail aktif (5 cabang Yen's Baby Shop & 3 cabang Borma Fashion) serta 1 Head Office.
about.p2: Berpengalaman memimpin transformasi sistem retail dari lokal menjadi terpusat di Head Office, standarisasi 1 Barang = 1 SKU Universal, manajemen stock opname lapangan, pemeliharaan hardware/jaringan/CCTV, serta perancangan aplikasi full stack modern dengan Laravel, React, Flutter, dan database SQL Server/MySQL.

projects.title: RETAIL ATTENDANCE & HR SYSTEM v2.0
projects.description: Aplikasi presensi terpadu multi-cabang dengan validasi geolocation real-time, foto selfie anti-mock location, dan backoffice approval cuti/lembur berbasis Laravel.
projects.impact: Digunakan staf di seluruh cabang dengan akurasi presensi real-time 100%

projects.title: CENTRALIZED RETAIL BACKOFFICE & MASTER SKU ENGINE
projects.description: Transformasi sistem dari database lokal menjadi terpusat di Head Office, standarisasi 1 Barang = 1 SKU Universal, manajemen SPK mutasi antar-cabang, dan alur stock opname terstruktur.
projects.impact: Menghilangkan selisih kode barang dan menyatukan sinkronisasi data 8 cabang retail

projects.title: MULTI-TENANT LAUNDRY SAAS PLATFORM
projects.description: Arsitektur platform SaaS multi-tenant otomatis: customer daftar ➔ sistem otomatis membuat subdomain toko ➔ login POS & Dashboard khusus tenant ➔ Superadmin monitoring.
projects.impact: Otomatisasi pembuatan toko digital instan dan manajemen multi-cabang bisnis

projects.title: ESTEHATAN POS & SMART WHATSAPP LOYALTY
projects.description: Sistem Web POS kasir terintegrasi Customer View, registrasi loyalty member instan via nomor WhatsApp, dan cetak struk via Bluetooth Thermal Printer.
projects.impact: Mempercepat waktu checkout kasir dan meningkatkan retensi pelanggan melalui poin member

stages.title: ANALISIS PROSES BISNIS & AUDIT OPERASIONAL
stages.description: Audit alur kerja lantai toko (kasir, gudang, purchasing), pemetaan kendala di lapangan, identifikasi integrasi cabang, serta perumusan SLA.

stages.title: DESAIN SKEMA DATABASE & STANDARISASI SKU
stages.description: Merancang ERD relational database (SQL Server / MySQL), standarisasi 1 SKU universal, stored procedures untuk transaksi tinggi, dan kontrak REST API.

stages.title: PROTOTYPING & UI/UX WORKFLOW TOKO
stages.description: Mendesain antarmuka mobile APK (Flutter/React) & dashboard backoffice yang ergonomis, cepat diakses oleh kasir/staf toko, dan minim klik.

stages.title: PENGEMBANGAN FULL STACK & MOBILE (FLUTTER/LARAVEL)
stages.description: Pembangunan backend scalable dengan Laravel / Node.js serta aplikasi mobile Flutter / Capacitor APK dengan arsitektur bersih dan terstruktur.

stages.title: UAT, STOCK OPNAME & INTEGRASI CABANG
stages.description: Uji fungsionalitas menyeluruh (User Acceptance Test), simulasi stock opname lapangan, validasi geolocation presensi, dan uji beban server.

stages.title: DEPLOYMENT PRODUKSI, CCTV/JARINGAN & ONBOARDING
stages.description: Deployment live server (VPS / On-Premise), setup auto-backup database harian, integrasi jaringan/CCTV toko, SOP operasional, serta pelatihan staf.

hero.badge: HEAD OF IT SUPPORT & FULL STACK DEVELOPER
hero.intro: UNIKOM Bandung Bachelor of Information Engineering graduate with a track record since 2017 managing technology operations of 8 retail branches (Yen's Baby Shop & Borma Fashion) + 1 Head Office, leading centralized system standardization, and building Laravel, React, & Flutter enterprise applications.

about.label: ABOUT SEPTIAN, S.KOM.
about.p1: Starting his career in October 2017 as a single field IT Support, he was trusted to lead as Head of IT Support for 8 active retail branches (5 Yen's Baby Shop branches & 3 Borma Fashion branches) as well as 1 Head Office.
about.p2: Experienced in leading the transformation of retail systems from local to centralized at the Head Office, standardization of 1 item = 1 Universal SKU, field stock taking management, hardware/network/CCTV maintenance, as well as designing modern full stack applications with Laravel, React, Flutter, and SQL Server/MySQL databases.

projects.title: RETAIL ATTENDANCE & HR SYSTEM v2.0
projects.description: Multi-branch integrated attendance application with real-time geolocation validation, anti-mock location selfie photos, and Laravel-based leave/overtime backoffice approval.
projects.impact: Used by staff in all branches with 100% real-time attendance accuracy

projects.title: CENTRALIZED RETAIL BACKOFFICE & MASTER SKU ENGINE
projects.description: System transformation from a local database to a centralized one at the Head Office, standardization of 1 Item = 1 Universal SKU, inter-branch mutation SPK management, and structured stock taking flow.
projects.impact: Eliminate differences in item codes and unify data synchronization for 8 retail branches

projects.title: MULTI-TENANT LAUNDRY SAAS PLATFORM
projects.description: Automatic multi-tenant SaaS platform architecture: customer list ➔ automatic system creating shop subdomains ➔ tenant-specific POS login & Dashboard ➔ Superadmin monitoring.
projects.impact: Automate instant digital store creation and multi-branch business management

projects.title: ESTEHATAN POS & SMART WHATSAPP LOYALTY
projects.description: Web POS cashier system integrated with Customer View, instant loyalty member registration via WhatsApp number, and print receipts via Bluetooth Thermal Printer.
projects.impact: Speed ​​up cashier checkout times and increase customer retention through member points

stages.title: BUSINESS PROCESS ANALYSIS & OPERATIONAL AUDIT
stages.description: Shop floor workflow audit (cashier, warehouse, purchasing), mapping of constraints in the field, identification of branch integration, and formulation of SLAs.

stages.title: DATABASE SCHEME DESIGN & SKU STANDARDIZATION
stages.description: Designing ERD relational database (SQL Server / MySQL), standardization of 1 universal SKU, stored procedures for high transactions, and REST API contracts.

stages.title: SHOP PROTOTYPING & UI/UX WORKFLOW
stages.description: Designing a mobile APK (Flutter/React) interface & backoffice dashboard that is ergonomic, quickly accessed by cashiers/store staff, and requires minimal clicks.

stages.title: FULL STACK & MOBILE DEVELOPMENT (FLUTTER/LARAVEL)
stages.description: Scalable backend development with Laravel / Node.js as well as Flutter / Capacitor APK mobile applications with clean and structured architecture.

stages.title: UAT, STOCK OPNAME & BRANCH INTEGRATION
stages.description: Comprehensive functionality test (User Acceptance Test), field stock taking simulation, presence geolocation validation, and server load test.

stages.title: PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT, CCTV/NETWORK & ONBOARDING
stages.description: Live server deployment (VPS / On-Premise), daily database auto-backup setup, store network/CCTV integration, operational SOPs, and staff training.
